Democratize access to robotics
Our team has a clear and audacious mission that drives how we work, act and make decisions together. To democratize access to robotics, we consistently build for others with curiosity, purpose and a sense of urgency.
Join us
Who we are
A global team at the forefront of applied AI and automation
We are a steadily growing, multidisciplinary team of professionals. At Intrinsic, you’ll collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the field who care about solving big, seemingly intractable problems. Our culture empowers individual autonomy and impact from day one.
Where we are
A global perspective
With labs and offices in Mountain View, Munich and Singapore, we are bringing together a global team of experts with different backgrounds, skillsets and perspectives. This helps us approach old problems in new ways, which is what we do every day. Learn more about our team,  and meet some of us below.

Saskia
Software Engineer
I love the idea of enabling people to solve complex problems using robotics, without having to have years of experience or education. Robots are so versatile in how they can be implemented and what problems they can solve, and this should also be reflected in who can use them to solve these problems.

he/him
Marc
Automation Engineer
Hands-on work has always been part of my personal life, working with my father to maintain the family catamaran, and recently restoring a century-old, 10,000+ sq-ft machine shop. Professionally, making the switch from pure software engineering to automation felt like finally being able to bring my whole self to work. It filled me with child-like excitement to watch software step beyond abstract information processing to perform tangible actions in the real world.

He/Him
Thomas
Product Manager
I've always had a very broad interest in different fields of technology. It's interesting to see how people work together across disciplines to produce innovative products. What I love about my role at Intrinsic is the diversity of responsibilities – on the boundary of technology, project management and product. Also, I get to work with the brightest minds in different fields of technology and can learn from them everyday.

Martina
Software Engineer
I'm excited by the prospect of making production radically simpler and affordable, and bringing advanced capabilities to the production floor that aren't possible today. My hope is that we'll be able to unlock more local production for shorter supply chains and more efficient manufacturing – and to help more businesses bring automation to their production.

FAQ
More questions?
Does Intrinsic offer internships?
Yes, we have an internship program. Roles are usually posted at the beginning of the year. If a role is posted, we are currently accepting applications.
When will I hear back regarding my application?
If there is an interest in moving forward, a recruiter from Intrinsic will reach out to you.
A recruiter reached out to me from a company acquired by Intrinsic (Vicarious, Akasha, Open Source Robotics Corporation, etc.). Is this a legitimate point of contact for Intrinsic?
It is likely not legitimate. We are aware of several recruiting scams where people are posing as hiring managers for non-existent roles at Intrinsic. Please confirm the email address ends in @intrinsic.ai for anyone that reaches out to you.
